messages.text:
I can’t send a refund to your sister’s account; refunds can only go to the order’s original payment. Your old card issuer handles the credit, and I can’t promise when it will appear. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

The speaker is recorded as received back, and BRL 149.65 was paid for it. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/amount) If you’re happy for the refund to go to the original payment, tell me and I can prepare the proposal.

messages.text: No, I don’t want the refund sent to the original payment. I have my sister’s permission to use her account.
Under the policy, I can’t send the refund to another person’s account, even with your sister’s permission. A refund can only go to the order’s original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)
